sectionHeader.headline: THE 4-STEP REVOLUTION
sectionHeader.subheadline: Engineered from first principles to eradicate the synthetic compromises of legacy beverage manufacturing.

steps.title: Alpine Spring Purity
steps.subtitle: Protected Deep Aquifer Sourcing

claimSwap.standardReality: Synthetic flavor chemicals, artificial preservatives, and municipal tap water disguised under commercial branding.
claimSwap.canInnovation: Direct alpine mineral spring water naturally filtered through deep limestone strata with zero chemical additives.

steps.description: We harvest our water exclusively from high-altitude subterranean aquifers protected by natural geological basalt layers.

steps.title: Infinite Aluminum Loop
steps.subtitle: 100% Closed-Loop Recyclability

claimSwap.standardReality: Single-use petroleum plastics and multi-layer cartons that persist in oceanic ecosystems for over four hundred years.
claimSwap.canInnovation: Infinitely recyclable aerospace-grade aluminum that re-enters the manufacturing cycle within sixty days of collection.

steps.description: Aluminum cools forty percent faster than plastic or glass, protects internal liquid freshness from UV degradation, and leaves zero microplastic residue.

steps.title: Ionic Hydration Matrix
steps.subtitle: 450mg Bioavailable Marine Electrolytes

claimSwap.standardReality: Massive sucrose sugar loads and artificial sweetener syrups that trigger severe insulin spikes and rebound fatigue.
claimSwap.canInnovation: Precisely calibrated ionic ratios of potassium, magnesium, and Himalayan pink salts for deep cellular hydration.

steps.description: Formulated by metabolic scientists to replenish lost intracellular electrolytes without taxing digestive efficiency or spiking blood glucose levels.

steps.title: Cognitive Botanical Flow
steps.subtitle: Organic Adaptogens & Clean Clarity

claimSwap.standardReality: Over-caffeinated synthetic jitter cocktails that spike nervous tension and destroy restorative sleep architecture.
claimSwap.canInnovation: Organic L-Theanine and nootropic green tea polyphenols calibrated to promote calm, laser-sharp cognitive flow.

steps.description: Harness nature's most potent botanical nootropics to sustain flow state through high-stress work sessions and strenuous athletic training.
